sections.title: Sound of es
paragraphs: The letter name is (эс) /ɛs/. Its main sound is a clear hiss. You hear it in the word (солнце) /ˈsont͡sə/, which means sun. This letter can make four sounds in total.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Put the tip of your tongue near your upper teeth. Blow air through the narrow gap. Keep your voice off. For the next sound, push the middle of your tongue up toward the roof of your mouth. For the last two sounds, turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Before hard consonants, the vowels а, о, у, ы, э, or at the end of a word, it sounds like (сом) /som/ or (нос) /nos/. Before е, ё, и, ю, я, or a soft sign, it sounds like (семь) /sʲemʲ/ or (сила) /ˈsʲiɫə/. Before voiced consonants, it changes to (сделать) /ˈzdʲeɫətʲ/. Before voiced soft consonants, it sounds like (сбить) /zʲbʲitʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not confuse the soft sound with the hiss in see. Lift the middle of your tongue higher toward the roof of your mouth. Also, do not keep the sound voiceless before voiced consonants. Make sure your vocal cords shake so the sound changes smoothly.
